# Stonebridge Construction

> Stonebridge Construction delivers commercial, industrial, and infrastructure construction projects with engineering precision. Founded in 1978, the company pairs architectural excellence with a commitment to longevity, safety, and durable structures.

Key pages:

- [Home](https://stonebridge.com/): Company overview, leadership team, key capabilities, and recent featured projects.
- [About](https://stonebridge.com/about): Company legacy since 1978, mission and values, leadership team, and certifications (ISO 9001, ISO 45001, IL LIC. 104-002188).
- [Expertise](https://stonebridge.com/expertise): Industries served - commercial, industrial, healthcare, education, government, and hospitality.
- [Services](https://stonebridge.com/services): Core services - construction management, general contracting, design-build, preconstruction, and specialty services across sectors.
- [Projects](https://stonebridge.com/projects): Portfolio of completed projects across commercial, industrial, and infrastructure categories.
- [Contact](https://stonebridge.com/contact): Project inquiries, consultation requests, office location, and contact details.
- [Privacy Policy](https://stonebridge.com/privacy): How Stonebridge Construction collects, uses, and protects visitor information.
- [Terms of Service](https://stonebridge.com/terms): Terms governing use of the Stonebridge Construction website.

## Company overview

- Company name: Stonebridge Construction
- Tagline: Engineering Excellence
- Founded: 1978
